unit: source registration rows, duplicates retained; not unique vehicles
filterContract: Precomputed national monthly history and fixed January–latest-month regional sample; dashboard filters do not recompute these files.
classificationVintage: Retrospective BD classification from reviewed source snapshot, not historical as-of reconstruction.

selic_effective_month.transformation: Rate: YoY percentage-point change; levels: YoY relative change; residualized month effects and linear trend.
selic_effective_month.warning: Association is not causation. Positive lag means macro leads registrations. Multiple lags and overlapping YoY observations invalidate naive significance claims; no p-values or causal response surface.
